items.name: file-preview
items.title: FilePreview
items.description: Single-asset preview block — image, video, audio, PDF (via iframe), with a graceful icon + download fallback for everything else (text, code, archives, unknown). Compose inside your own carousel for galleries.

items.name: signed-url
items.title: getPresignedDownloadUrl + getPresignedUploadUrl
items.description: Time-limited presigned URLs for private R2/S3 objects. Lazy-built S3 client; supports R2 via endpoint + forcePathStyle env. Download URLs serve private assets; upload URLs let the browser PUT directly (no server proxy).

items.name: upload-file
items.title: uploadFile (client-side)
items.description: Browser-side upload helper. Fetches a presigned PUT URL from your server, streams the file via XHR with progress events + abort support. Returns { key, publicUrl }. Pair with `signed-url` on the server.

items.name: image-upload
items.title: ImageUpload (drag-drop + preview)
items.description: Drag-drop image upload with client-side type+size validation, progress bar, preview, replace/remove. Pairs with `upload-file` + your `signed-url` endpoint.

items.name: gallery
items.title: Gallery (grid + lightbox)
items.description: Responsive image grid with built-in fullscreen lightbox. Keyboard navigation (←/→ to step, Esc to close), backdrop click closes, optional download button, body-scroll-lock while open. Renders via next/image with `unoptimized` escape hatch for arbitrary sources.

items.name: csv-import
items.title: CsvImport (4-step wizard)
items.description: Upload → Map → Validate → Import wizard. Parses CSV client-side (handles quoted fields + embedded quotes), auto-guesses column mappings, runs per-field `validate(value)` and required checks, then POSTs the mapped rows to your handler. Server response can include per-row error info that's rendered in the final step.

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone (generic drag-drop)
items.description: Generic drag-drop zone for custom file flows (avatar cropper, single-file CSV pickers, etc.). Returns `{ accepted, rejected }` with per-file rejection reasons (`type` or `size`). MIME globs + extension matchers, max-size limit, multiple toggle, keyboard activation.
